recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a female figure in 1970s-inspired western attire, featuring exaggerated bell-bottom trousers, a velvet blazer, and a wide-brimmed hat. The subject is centered against a clean, off-white studio background with a slight vintage grain. Bold, multi-colored retro typography is stacked in the upper left corner, while a secondary nameplate sits in the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: The verticality of the subject's flared trousers anchors the composition.
The three-color typographic stack mirrors the color palette of the subject's clothing.
The off-center text placement balances the central figure's pose.
coreInvariants: Muted 1970s color palette (olive, maroon, teal, mustard)
Clean, minimalist studio backdrop with warm lighting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The wide flare of the trousers at the bottom of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the colorful top-left text, moves down the subject's face and torso, and settles on the wide flares at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white space surrounding the subject to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/Cream background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep olive green and navy blue in the clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Maroon/Burgundy in the hat and text; Teal in the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with a matte, film-like finish.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric Sans-Serif with Art Deco influences
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'U' has a deep, rounded bowl
The 'Y' has a high junction point
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric sans-serif for impact paired with a condensed serif for signature-style elegance.

avoid: Distressed or grunge textures on text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s feel and circular counters.
Matches the high-waisted Art Deco geometry.
Appropriate for the secondary serif nameplate.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photograph of a woman in 70s western fashion: olive green satin bell-bottoms, a dark velvet blazer, and a maroon wide-brimmed hat with a feather. The background is a flat, warm off-white studio wall with soft lighting and a subtle film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of stacked geometric sans-serif text in the top left corner using olive, maroon, and teal colors. Add a smaller name in a condensed serif font in the bottom right corner in dark brown.

verificationChecks: Is the typography stacked and color-coded?
Is the background a clean, warm-toned neutral?
Does the overall image have a 1970s film aesthetic?

adjustableVariables: Color of the individual text lines
Specific fabric texture of the blazer (velvet vs. suede)
mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text colors match the clothing accents.
Check that the flares of the pants are symmetrical and prominent.
Verify the grain is subtle and not distracting.
Confirm the typography is perfectly aligned to the left margin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Vintage Fashion Style] + [Muted 70s Palette] + [Geometric Stacked Typography] + [Minimalist Studio Backdrop]
